AI Notes.value: Mirko Borsche, b. 1971 Tegernsee, Germany. Founder and principal of Bureau Borsche (est. 2007, Munich), a studio of ~10 people specialising in editorial design, identity systems, and art direction. Career trajectory: communication design at FH Augsburg + postgrad Kingston (1992-93); freelance AD at Start Advertising (1996-97, clients Levis, MTV, Mercedes-Benz); AD at Springer & Jacoby; AD for Jetzt magazine/SZ (1999-2007); launched NEON youth magazine (~2002) for Stern/Gruner+Jahr; AD for BMW Mini Group; Creative Director for ZEITmagazin from 2007 to present. Over 30 years of practice; one of the most cited German graphic designers internationally. Studio-level output: Bureau Borsche produces full visual identity programmes (Bayerische Staatsoper CI 2021-22, Venezia FC, Inter Milan, Rimowa), editorial design (ZEITmagazin, Numero Berlin, The Face), fashion campaigns (Supreme, Balenciaga, Birkenstock, On Running), and sports kit design. IDI Presidents Prize 2018, Designpreis Munchen 2026. Work Status Studio: self-founded practice, confirmed on own site and LinkedIn. Autonomy 5: fully independent founder, sets his own direction, 30+ yrs experience, internationally recognised. Capabilities currently set to Graphic design by Jonathan; Identity systems and Creative direction also strongly defensible from published work (flagged in Open Questions).
